_doc: Marines + World Government structural hierarchy. Six tiers from the Five Elders down to common soldiers. Each tier lists current + notable historical members with brief notes.

tiers.label: Government Apex
tiers.summary: Beyond the Marines — the true rulers of the world.

members.name: Nerona Imu
members.note: Hidden ruler, occupies the Empty Throne. Family name Nerona revealed; D. status confirmed.

members.name: Saint Jaygarcia Saturn
members.note: Spider-Ox true form. Known for immortality.

members.name: Saint Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro
members.note: Sabre-Toothed Cat true form. Wields the legendary blade Shimotsuki.

tiers.label: Fleet Admiral
tiers.summary: Supreme commander of the Marines, answers only to the Five Elders.

members.name: Sakazuki
members.note: Magu Magu no Mi (magma). Hard-line Absolute Justice.

members.name: Sengoku
members.note: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu. Now an Inspector General.

members.name: Kong
members.note: Stepped up to World Government Commander-in-Chief.

tiers.label: Admirals
tiers.summary: The Marines' top-tier combatants — three serving plus reserves.

members.name: Kuzan
members.note: Hie Hie no Mi (ice). Defected to Blackbeard Pirates.

members.name: Sakazuki
members.note: Promoted to Fleet Admiral after defeating Aokiji.

tiers.label: Vice Admirals
tiers.summary: Senior Marine officers — most have powerful Devil Fruits or proven Haki.

members.name: Monkey D. Garp
members.role: Vice Admiral / Hero of the Marines
members.note: Roger's lifelong rival. Trained Coby and others. D. carrier.

members.name: Onigumo
members.note: Six arms (Kumo Kumo no Mi: Rosamygale Grauvogeli, posthumous-revived Ancient Zoan).

members.name: Vergo
members.note: Doflamingo's mole. Killed by Law on Punk Hazard.

tiers.label: Cipher Pol Aigis Zero (CP0)
tiers.summary: World Government's most secret intelligence + assassination unit. Operates above Marine command. Wears white, faceless masks.

members.name: Rob Lucci
members.note: Awakened Neko Neko no Mi: Leopard. Egghead arc.

members.name: Spandam
members.note: Yoru sword sheath wielder; villain of Enies Lobby.

tiers.label: Cipher Pol 9 (CP9)
tiers.summary: Predecessor to CP0 — the unit Lucci, Kaku, Jabra, Kalifa, Blueno, Fukurō, Kumadori served in. Disbanded after Enies Lobby; survivors moved to CP0.

tiers.label: SWORD
tiers.summary: Secret Marine cell — operates outside the formal chain of command. Members can resign on paper while staying active. Egghead-era reveal.

members.name: Coby
members.note: Promoted from Marineford rookie. Hostage on Hachinosu.

members.name: X Drake
members.note: Tobi Roppo defector — actually a SWORD plant.

tiers.label: Marine Branch Captains & Special
tiers.summary: Captains, instructors, base commanders, and special-operations leads.
